title: Relicera
body:
Relicera is a mod about discovering and restoring relics.

Ancient relics do not reveal their power immediately. Many of them are broken when first found. To restore them, Players must gather unusual materials and place them in a relic repair table.

# Features
- Powerful Curios accessories with distinct mechanics;
- Special relic materials obtained through exploration, combat, crafting, and world interactions;
- Original lore, names, and worldbuilding.

# Progression
The mod encourages players to explore different parts of Minecraft:
- Ancient ruins;
- Sniffer-related discoveries;
- Unpopular materials, such as touchflower, sherd.
- Moon phase.

# Notes
This mod is still in development. More relics, materials, and advancements may be added in future updates.
